title: Hot tunes versus real march bands; Rene at the Eureka rehearsals
summary: People wanted hot tunes from Rene's band but went to Eureka or Tuxedo for marches. Rene attended Eureka rehearsals and left.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh yeah, we played that, but Velsheim would play that man. Because that's on the record. They want all that gut books, they want Tiger Rack, High Society, Clannett Marble, the blues, all that kind of stuff they wanted, you know? All they wanted was something hot, man. But see when they wanted a nice march band, they go get the Eureka or either the Tuxedo band, you know them fellas. A Eureka band had some nice marches. I played once or twice and I went to their rehearsal.

That's the time, I don't know if the place they called, Big Duval's used to be on Howard Avenue and Ramport, upstairs. When they first organized, I could have been their drummer. But they had some stuff there the drummer couldn't play. And I cut that stuff loose man, and they wanted me by all of me. But I was a fella, I don't know, I never did like to, you know, friggin' on earth. I said no, I didn't play. I remember who was playing drums too. So what I did, I just stopped going to the rehearsal, you see? Stopped going. They used to rehearse a little. That's the only thing you're going to make a good band is rehearse them. Rehearse them, just like I tell these people, you see? They got to rehearse them. I got a fella, I think he's from San Luis or either, California, he's played bass player in there. I don't know how long he's going to stay around here. But I've been trying to get a nice band. You're talking about some nice music. I want you to hear it some of these times. What about the Eureka? Who was in the Eureka then?
